title: Avoid duplicate obsolete runs
summary: Concurrency can group related runs. cancel-in-progress can stop an older run when a newer run in the same group starts.
introduction: Concurrency can group related runs. cancel-in-progress can stop an older run when a newer run in the same group starts. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: Concurrency can group related runs. cancel-in-progress can stop an older run when a newer run in the same group starts.

blocks.title: Avoid duplicate obsolete runs

blocks.text: Runs for the same ref share the group. This can save work for checks whose old result is no longer needed.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain a job where cancelling halfway would need care.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: Do not blindly cancel a deployment or other action that has important partial effects.
For more detail later, use this [GitHub Actions further reading](https://docs.github.com/en/actions).
